New Westminster lots and land for sale: vacant land and building lots on the MLS®. Zoning decides what can be built, so check the zone and the City’s plans for the exact lot before you offer. Across all home types the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® benchmark in New Westminster was $719,600 in September 2026.
New Westminster lots and land sold, November 2025 to October 2026
Fewer than 3 lots and land sold in New Westminster, too few to describe.
When so few sell, one sale is the whole picture, so this page does not quote a typical price. Ask Jared for the recent sales near the address you are looking at.

blocks.source: Source: Greater Vancouver REALTORS®, MLS® Home Price Index, September 2026 (released October 2, 2026). The benchmark is the board’s modelled price for a typical home of this type, not an average of sales. The index sets January 2005 at 100. Changes are as published; the text below calls a change a rise or fall only at 1.5% or more.

blocks.text: New Westminster: the all home types benchmark was $719,600 in September 2026. Over the past year it fell 8.2%; over three months it fell 2.1%; over the last month it was little changed (-0.4%, under the 1.5% we need before calling it a move). Longer term, over 3 years it fell 13.5%; over 5 years it was little changed (-1.0%, under the 1.5% we need before calling it a move); over 10 years it rose 32.6%.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: New Westminster houses listed went from 156 in June to 164 in September, a rise of 5.1%.
Colleges and universities in New Westminster

4 colleges and universities are located in the City of New Westminster: 3 in Public Post-Secondary, 1 in Private and Out-of-Province Degree Granting. This lists where a school building is, from the BC Data Catalogue and the other official sources read on November 1, 2026. It is not a catchment list: which school serves a home is set by address, so check the exact address with the school district.

items.t: New Westminster real estate market stats

faq.q: Is New Westminster a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In September 2026 houses in New Westminster had a sales ratio of 5%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market, and condos and townhomes 15%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many lots and land are for sale in New Westminster?
faq.a: The listing feed on this page shows what is active now, and the number changes daily. Ask Jared and he will send you the lots and land in New Westminster that match what you want.

faq.q: Can Jared alert me when lots and land come up in New Westminster?
faq.a: Yes. Tell him the area, price range and must-haves and he will alert you the day a match is listed.

faq.q: Where can I see all New Westminster homes?
faq.a: The New Westminster homes for sale page covers every home type, and the New Westminster market stats page has the monthly figures.
